1: use proc_macro2::{Span, TokenStream};
2: use quote::{quote, ToTokens};
3: 
4: pub const MESSAGE_ATTR: &str = "rtype";
5: 
6: pub fn expand(ast: &syn::DeriveInput) -> TokenStream {
7:     let item_type = {
8:         match get_attribute_type_multiple(ast, MESSAGE_ATTR) {
9:             Ok(ty) => match ty.len() {
10:                 1 => ty[0].clone(),
11:                 _ => {
12:                     return syn::Error::new(
13:                         Span::call_site(),
14:                         format!(
15:                             "#[{}(type)] takes 1 parameters, given {}",
16:                             MESSAGE_ATTR,
17:                             ty.len()
18:                         ),
19:                     )
20:                     .to_compile_error()
21:                 }
22:             },
23:             Err(err) => return err.to_compile_error(),
24:         }
25:     };
26: 
27:     let name = &ast.ident;
28:     let (impl_generics, ty_generics, where_clause) = ast.generics.split_for_impl();
29: 
30:     let item_type = item_type
31:         .map(ToTokens::into_token_stream)
32:         .unwrap_or_else(|| quote! { () });
33: 
34:     quote! {
35:         impl #impl_generics ::actix::Message for #name #ty_generics #where_clause {
36:             type Result = #item_type;
37:         }
38:     }
39: }
40: 
41: fn get_attribute_type_multiple(
42:     ast: &syn::DeriveInput,
43:     name: &str,
44: ) -> syn::Result<Vec<Option<syn::Type>>> {
45:     let attr = ast
46:         .attrs
47:         .iter()
48:         .find_map(|a| {
49:             let a = a.parse_meta();
50:             match a {
51:                 Ok(meta) => {
52:                     if meta.path().is_ident(name) {
53:                         Some(meta)
54:                     } else {
55:                         None
56:                     }
57:                 }
58:                 _ => None,
59:             }
60:         })
61:         .ok_or_else(|| {
62:             syn::Error::new(Span::call_site(), format!("Expect an attribute `{}`", name))
63:         })?;
64: 
65:     if let syn::Meta::List(ref list) = attr {
66:         Ok(list
67:             .nested
68:             .iter()
69:             .map(|m| meta_item_to_ty(m).ok())
70:             .collect())
71:     } else {
72:         Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(
73:             attr,
74:             format!("The correct syntax is #[{}(type, type, ...)]", name),
75:         ))
76:     }
77: }
78: 
79: fn meta_item_to_ty(meta_item: &syn::NestedMeta) -> syn::Result<syn::Type> {
80:     match meta_item {
81:         syn::NestedMeta::Meta(syn::Meta::Path(ref path)) => match path.get_ident() {
82:             Some(ident) => syn::parse_str::<syn::Type>(&ident.to_string())
83:                 .map_err(|_| syn::Error::new_spanned(ident, "Expect type")),
84:             None => Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(path, "Expect type")),
85:         },
86:         syn::NestedMeta::Meta(syn::Meta::NameValue(val)) => match val.path.get_ident() {
87:             Some(ident) if ident == "result" => {
88:                 if let syn::Lit::Str(ref s) = val.lit {
89:                     if let Ok(ty) = syn::parse_str::<syn::Type>(&s.value()) {
90:                         return Ok(ty);
91:                     }
92:                 }
93:                 Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(&val.lit, "Expect type"))
94:             }
95:             _ => Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(
96:                 &val.lit,
97:                 r#"Expect `result = "TYPE"`"#,
98:             )),
99:         },
100:         syn::NestedMeta::Lit(syn::Lit::Str(ref s)) => syn::parse_str::<syn::Type>(&s.value())
101:             .map_err(|_| syn::Error::new_spanned(s, "Expect type")),
102: 
103:         meta => Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(meta, "Expect type")),
104:     }
105: }

21:                             MESSAGE_ATTR,

23:                         ),
